decisions.statement: The one thing a reader can do here is go to Google.
The browser asks the handler where Google is and goes where the handler says.
Only a host named here is a target the url may ask for.
A reason the url carries back from a refused sign-in is shown to the reader.
The native shell asks its own layer for a code and trades that code for a session.
A native shell holding no handover plugin is told to update rather than sent out.
No reason is shown where the reader closed the sign-in themselves.
A traded session lands the reader where a browser sign-in would have landed them.

definition: the card a reader signs in from, holding the one button Google answers
